Class SocketServer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.network.socket.server.SocketServer
public class SocketServer extends Object
Socket side of the server. It listens on a ServerSocket and accepts client connections, sharing the same GameModel, GameController and EndGameService as the RMI server so socket and RMI clients play in one game.

For each accepted connection it starts a SocketClientHandler (the server-side connection, run on its own thread to read requests) and registers a PlayerVirtualView as a model observer, so that client receives updates.

  • Method Details

    • start

      public void start()
      Accept loop: blocks waiting for clients and, for each one, starts its SocketClientHandler thread and attaches a PlayerVirtualView observer. Connections arriving once the game is in progress (and no reconnection window is open) are refused — the socket is closed immediately — so outsiders cannot join a game that has already started; see GameController.acceptsNewConnections(). Per-connection errors are logged and do not stop the loop.
